nodes.name: The Semantic Tug-of-War: How Transformers 'Think'
nodes.summary: Part 4 lesson (order 6) on self-attention: RNN signal decay vs direct access, geometric intuition for the scaled-dot-product formula, Q/K/V projections, multi-head attention, attention sinks, and the context window. Hosts four interactive widgets (long-distance-dependency canvas, the step-by-step 'anatomy of attention' 2D SVG walkthrough, a Q/K/V subspace projection plot, and a self-attention connectivity web + matrix).
nodes.languageNotes: Lesson PHP template with COURSE_METADATA (part 4, order 6, math 65); large inline <style> block for the anatomy-of-attention widget; Markdown blocks gated by data-mathlevel and topic-blocks for optional deep dives.

nodes.name: attentionlab.js
nodes.summary: Interactive module behind the attentionlab lesson: a long-distance-dependency Transformer-vs-RNN demo, a 'neural universe' 3D embedding plot, a self-attention web/matrix visualizer, an 11-step 'anatomy of attention' SVG walkthrough with editable numbers, and a Q/K/V subspace projection visualization.
nodes.languageNotes: Large (6k+ lines) vanilla-JS module bootstrapped by loadAttentionModule(); mixes Plotly, raw canvas 2D, and hand-rolled SVG; theme-aware via themeColor()/window.__MN_DARK; includes a click-to-edit number system and an on-page debug panel.

nodes.name: loadAttentionModule
nodes.summary: Module entry point that bootstraps all four attentionlab widgets (SelfAttentionLab, AttentionAnatomy, universe plot, QKV subspace viz, LDD demo) and registers theme-change re-render hooks guarded on section visibility.

nodes.name: initAttentionAnatomy
nodes.summary: Initializes the step-by-step 'anatomy of attention' interactive: wires up step navigation, token-count and example-set selectors, and kicks off the first render of the AttentionAnatomy engine.

nodes.name: initQKVSubspaceViz
nodes.summary: Sets up the 3D visualization of Q/K/V linear projections as distinct 2D subspaces (planes) inside the embedding space, including rotation controls and theme handling.

nodes.name: updateLDD
nodes.summary: Redraws the long-distance-dependency canvas: for the current distractor count it shows the Transformer's flat attention signal next to the RNN's exponentially decaying signal, plus the live math readout.

nodes.name: runUniverse
nodes.summary: Renders the 'neural universe' Plotly 3D scatter of a small word-embedding vocabulary, highlighting the tokens typed by the user to illustrate the distributional hypothesis.

nodes.name: softmax
nodes.summary: Numerically stable softmax (max-subtraction before exponentiating) shared by the LDD demo and the anatomy-of-attention computations.

nodes.name: AttentionAnatomy
nodes.summary: The step-by-step engine behind the 'anatomy of attention' walkthrough: tracks the current step and token-set, and drives the equation panel, the editable computation table, the 2D SVG vector scene (arrows, angle arcs, bar plots, attention matrix), hover tooltips with per-step math breakdowns, and a live debug console.

nodes.name: ATTN_2D
nodes.summary: Shared 2D state and math engine for the attention walkthrough: holds queries/keys/values per token, computes scores, scaled scores, exponentials, attention weights, and outputs, and supports changing token count and example sets.

nodes.name: SelfAttentionLab
nodes.summary: Interactive 'connectivity web' for the sentence 'The hunter sees the bear': renders the token stream, draws attention threads on a canvas, and shows the attention-matrix scoreboard with hover explanations of dot-product scores.

nodes.name: LDD
nodes.summary: State object for the long-distance-dependency demo: holds the distractor count, subject/pronoun sentence data, and the signal-strength series fed to the updateLDD canvas draw.
